executive_summary: Nineteenth consecutive week of absolute zero trades executed. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy has been completely non-functional for approximately 4.5 months, producing zero trades across all market regimes including strongly trending markets. This is not a parameter tuning problem — the core signal generation pipeline is structurally broken or the zone identification criteria are so restrictive that no tradeable setup ever qualifies. The strategy must be replaced or fundamentally rebuilt from scratch; incremental parameter adjustments are categorically useless.
target_progress: 0% — infinitely below 70% target. No trades have been generated in 19 weeks.
regime_assessment: Regime detection appears to be functioning (correctly identifying trending_up for 6 of 7 days), but it is entirely irrelevant because the strategy generates zero trades regardless of regime. There is no evidence of misclassification, but also no evidence regime data is being consumed by the strategy at all.

symbol_changes.remove_reason: No symbol data exists — zero trades means zero symbol-level signal. Cannot make data-driven symbol decisions.
symbol_changes.focus_reason: No basis for symbol focus. First priority is getting ANY trade to fire on ANY symbol.

dow_pattern: No day-of-week pattern can be identified. Zero trades across all days of week for 19 consecutive weeks. Day-of-week analysis is meaningless without trade data.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: After 19 weeks of zero trades, the ONLY useful diagnostic is to drastically lower all thresholds to determine whether the zone detection pipeline produces ANY candidates at all. If trades fire at min_score=30 and rr=1.0 but not at 75/2.0, we have an overly restrictive filter problem. If trades still don't fire, the zone identification or order placement logic is fundamentally broken. This is a diagnostic step, not a production recommendation.

structural_recommendations.change: ABANDON Supply & Demand Zone strategy entirely. Deploy a proven, simple alternative strategy (e.g., EMA crossover with ATR-based stops, or Opening Range Breakout) as the primary strategy immediately. Keep S&D zones in a paper-trade diagnostic mode only.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Moving from 0 trades/week to an estimated 5-15 trades/week. Even a 40% win rate on a functioning strategy produces more value than 0 trades at any theoretical win rate.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a mandatory diagnostic logging layer that reports: (1) how many raw zones are identified per day, (2) how many pass the min_score filter, (3) how many generate order-eligible setups, (4) why each was rejected. Output this as a daily diagnostic report regardless of whether trades execute.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Identifies the exact pipeline stage where all signals are dying. Without this, we are debugging blind. Expected to pinpoint root cause within 2-3 trading days.

structural_recommendations.change: Add a 'canary trade' mechanism: if zero trades fire by Wednesday of any week, automatically lower min_score by 10 and rr_ratio by 0.3 for the remainder of the week as a self-healing circuit breaker against perpetual inactivity.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Prevents multi-week zero-trade streaks from extending indefinitely. Ensures at minimum some signal generation for learning and parameter calibration.

structural_recommendations.change: Audit the zone detection code for bugs: verify that price data is being fetched correctly, that zone boundaries are computed in the correct price units, that order placement logic matches the broker API's expected format, and that the build_days/test_days window isn't looking at stale or empty data.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: High probability that a code-level bug (e.g., timezone mismatch, empty data frame, off-by-one in candle indexing, or zone coordinates in wrong scale) is the root cause. Fixing would immediately restore functionality.
